transferMechanism.notes: California is not an NLC member and does not recognize compact privilege at all -- even though Texas is a compact member and the nurse may hold a multistate license, it has no effect in California. BRN's own page: 'To qualify for endorsement (reciprocity) into California... you must hold a current and active RN license in another state.' (Note BRN's own page loosely uses the word 'reciprocity' in parentheses next to 'endorsement' -- per Phase 3.0's documented mechanism distinctions, this is still classified endorsement: BRN issues its OWN license after review, there is no bilateral agreement recognizing the license directly.)
